parts.temporal: Empirical last-input sampler with damped composition growth + organiser heart-chamber donor rule (x0.05) + blood held at 0.8x its last-input share; no target-derived constants
parts.perturbation: T3 program from an earlier agent run (second distinct T3 program on the archived paired dev ranking)
parts.heart: Real cells of the latest input; heart-chamber crop at native size when the target is a dissected heart
parts.embryo: Expression mixture of both brackets placed one-to-one on a distinct subsample of the nearer bracket embryo (native coordinates, no stretch)
